Focus_C002.observed: China fourth-generation ordinary Sedan; old hood-mounted Ford emblem and narrow chrome horizontal grille, full front three-quarter view. Not the verified wide-grille 2020 China facelift front.
Focus_C002.reason: Published source mapping explicitly says IV Рестайлинг (China Market) 2020-2022. Some old-styled trims continued after 2020, so old front alone cannot prove out-of-range, but current evidence cannot bind this exact vehicle/front/trim to the mapped facelift. Photo year is not model year.

Focus_C003.observed: Actual original downloaded and viewed: old hood emblem/chrome bar grille, frontal view; not 2022 new-front design. Different car from C002.
Focus_C003.reason: 2022-06-25 capture date coincides with launch day but does not establish model year or second facelift. Do not replace C002 with C003 solely for 2022 date; do not mix 2022 second-facelift front into 2020-2022 China-first-facelift request.

dimension_ids: Lada (ВАЗ) Vesta SW Sport Wagon 2022-2026 RU
Vesta_NG_Sport.reason: Genuine new-generation Sport Sedan and Wagon are confirmed for Russian-market production February 2026 and sales March 2026. 2022-2026 is aggregate NG family range, not proof Sport existed every year. Sportline is separately documented and must not be substituted. Need same 2026 Sport body-specific actual front source before production; dimensions not recertified.

Axio_C002.observed: Source original viewed; vertical chrome grille, projector lights, circular fog lamps, bumper, mirror indicators, narrow Japanese Sedan body agree with Toyota 200810 Luxel image.
Axio_C002.limits: No exact production year, engine/drivetrain, individual mechanical equipment, 2013 continuation, or dimensions are certified. Generic Axio exterior representative only; keep source trim details.

Fielder_C003.observed: Source viewed: ordinary long-roof Wagon, double horizontal black grille, pointed inner lamp casing, wide lower opening and round fog blank. Matches ordinary X-based post-facelift Toyota 2011 body photo, not AEROTOURER mesh appearance.
Fielder_C003.correction: Initial suspicion of pre-facelift was withdrawn after finding ordinary X-based official image. 200810 catalog uses shared Aero imagery and cannot exclude ordinary X. This final judgment supersedes provisional messages.
Fielder_C003.limits: Source halogen lamp internals must be preserved; do not copy official comparison HID/projector internals or claim special edition. No exact production year/2013 continuity/engine/drive/dimensions certification.

Camry_market_rule.reason: RU labels the dataset scope; absence of an explicit market field does not establish Australian/US exterior equivalence. Rules demand each requirement vehicle/generation/body/version/market verification. Australian/US images may remain candidates with truthful market metadata; require exact pre/post-facelift and exterior/configuration mapping to the target generation before reference qualification. Do not call them Russian specification. No blanket prohibition is inferred: body-equivalence evidence can permit reuse.
Camry_market_rule.currently_reviewed_metadata_only: source_b/camry-candidates.json; no production acceptance or market equivalence granted here.

E120_Europe_Wagon_3009926.observed: Front three-quarter actual original: long wagon roof/rails and extended rear side window; four body-colour horizontal grille bars, more pointed inner lamp corner, large lower centre intake with separate dark side recesses. Corresponds to Toyota official 2004-2007 estate picture; retain source wheelcaps/no fog lamp details, not official alloy/fog trim.
E120_Europe_Wagon_3009926.limits: European E120 ordinary Wagon representative; not Japanese Fielder, not Russian-spec claim. European facelift took place in 2004, not proven by queue start 2003 or capture 2007. Exact engine/year/drivetrain not certified.

E120_Europe_Wagon_3332357.observed: Front three-quarter actual original: wagon long roof/rails, chrome-edge black mesh upper grille with Toyota badge, rounder lamps, narrow lower opening and elongated fog lamps. Corresponds to Toyota 2002-2004 official estate front image.
E120_Europe_Wagon_3332357.limits: European E120 ordinary Wagon representative; no Japanese Fielder applicability or Russian-spec claim; no pre-2002 European launch or exact individual year certified from queue or photo.

E120_Japan_Sedan_80109931.observed: Actual provided derivative viewed. C family badge, four narrow chrome horizontal bars, rectangular four-lamp housing with prominent inner reflector, low horizontal intake/dark side blanks, separate Sedan trunk correspond to official Japanese 27 April 2004 Corolla 1.5G picture.
E120_Japan_Sedan_80109931.limits: Japanese E120 representative, not US E130 or European/Russian specification. Source is an API derivative (actual 1920x1432) with original full-resolution 429 recorded by source_c. Do not claim original full-resolution download. No exact manufacturing year or 2003-front equivalence certified.
